description: This file defines a class for an HTML Purifier Injector that modifies anchor elements to display their URL instead of linking, enhancing security or transparency in content rendering.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_DisplayLinkURI
classes.description: An injector class that replaces the href of anchor tags with the URL text in the output.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an HTML element, currently does nothing.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of an anchor element, replaces the href attribute with its URL in the output.
